landing_faq_1_question: Shin wannan manhajar tana aiki ba tare da intanet a gonakin karkara ba?
landing_faq_1_answer: Wasu ayyukan gona suna goyan bayan amfani ba tare da intanet ba kuma suna yin daidaitawa (synchronization) idan intanet din ya dawo. Binciken girgije (Cloud) da bayanan waje na yanzu suna bukatar intanet; samuwarsa ya dogara da na'ura da kuma yadda aka tsara shi.
landing_faq_2_question: Shin ina bukatar wayar salula mai tsada don amfani da GPExts?
landing_faq_2_answer: Manhajar yanar gizo tana goyan bayan burauzar wayar hannu. Samun SMS da USSD ya dogara da mai bayar da sabis da tsarin kamfanin sadarwa; tuntuɓi ƙungiyarka don sanin hanyoyin da ake goyan baya.
landing_faq_3_question: Shin GPExts kyauta ne ga kowane manomi?
landing_faq_3_answer: Samuwa da farashi sun dogara ne akan ƙungiyarka da kuma yadda aka aiwatar da shi. Duba cikakkun bayanai na tsarin yanzu kafin yin rajista.
landing_faq_4_question: Wadanne amfanin gona da cututtukan shuke-shuke ne ake goyan baya a halin yanzu?
landing_faq_4_answer: Bayanan cututtukan sun hada da amfanin gona da yanayi da dama, amma iyaka da daidaito sun bambanta. Sakamakon shawarwari ne, ba tabbataccen ganewar asali ba; tuntuɓi masanin yankinku.
landing_faq_5_question: Zan iya sauraron shawara a cikin yaren gida na?
landing_faq_5_answer: Goyan bayan harshe da magana sun bambanta dangane da fasali, burauza, da mai bayar da sabis da aka saita. Duba harshen da ake da shi da kuma zaɓuɓɓukan sauti a cikin tsarin da kake amfani da shi.
landing_faq_6_question: Ta yaya Jami'an Fadada Aikin Gona da Ma'aikatu suke amfani da GPExts?
landing_faq_6_answer: Jami'an bayar da shawarwari suna amfani da GPExts a kan babura da kuma lokacin ziyarar gona don yin rijistar manoma, tsara iyakokin gona, rubuta tarihin abubuwan da aka lura, da kuma daidaita matakan dakile barkewar cututtuka. Ma'aikatu da ƙungiyoyin haɗin gwiwa suna amfani da shafin yanar gizo don duba taswirar zafi na barkewar cututtuka a gundumomi da kuma bayanan gona.
